newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks fall before close on shooting report.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks fall before close on shooting report.

text.p: Taiwan share prices fell shortly before Thursday's close as reports circulated that gunmen had shot five people dead in a county magistrate's home and critically wounded the official himself.
With 10 minutes to go, the index was down 36.38 points or 0.54 percent to 6,692.98. Turnover was an active T$74 billion.
"This shooting reminds people of Taiwan's poor social order. It will have a negative impact on investment willingness," one broker said.
